categories.name: Tokenized Treasuries
categories.content: Tokenized Treasuries feature blockchain-native representations of marketable sovereign debt including T-bills, T-notes, and T-bonds that offer 24/7 on-chain access to yields through regulated, asset-backed tokens.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: Strategy Games
categories.content: Strategy game is a video game genre where players engage in planning, resource management, and decision-making to achieve specific objectives.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Sports Games
categories.content: Sports game simulates the playing of real-world sports including sports such as football, badminton and basketball.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Christmas Themed
categories.content: Meme coins themed around Christmas, inspired by holiday traditions, symbols, and celebrations.

categories.name: Move To Earn
categories.content: The move-to-earn model is often implemented through mobile applications that use technologies such as GPS tracking to monitor users' physical activity. These apps then reward users with tradable tokens or NFTs based on the distance they cover or the number of steps they take.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: DeFAI
categories.content: DeFAI or AIFI projects leverage AI to streamline and automate DeFi activities such as trading, staking, yield farming, market analysis, and investment optimization.

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Retail
categories.content: Retail involves the sale of goods and services to consumers for their personal use, rather than for resale on blockchain.

categories.name: Solana Token-2022
categories.content: Solana Token-2022 is a new token standard on Solana that provides additional fungible and non-fungible token functionality.

categories.name: Venice Ecosystem
categories.content: Venice is a decentralized, privacy-first AI network that provides permissionless and uncensored access to Large Language Models (LLMs) through a distributed compute architecture.
